LVGLab 0.12.0 is faster and tidier: quicker tab switches, a smooth LVGL preview, a new preferences window and a compact timeline.

## Downloads

| Platform | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 (x64), installer | `LVGLab-0.12.0-windows-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows 10/11 (x64), portable | `LVGLab-0.12.0-windows-x64.zip` |
| Linux (x64, glibc 2.35+) | `LVGLab-0.12.0-linux-x64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `LVGLab-0.12.0-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS (Intel) | `LVGLab-0.12.0-macos-x64.tar.gz` |

The Windows installer adds a Start menu entry and can associate `.lvglab` files. The archives need no
installation: unpack and start `lvglab` (`lvglab.exe` on Windows). Check downloads against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
On macOS, run `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine lvglab` once if the unsigned binary is refused.

## Faster

- Converted fonts and images are cached: the LVGL preview redraws in about 16 ms instead of about half a second with
  custom fonts, and the export reuses them as well.
- Switching between project tabs no longer reloads the fonts of the editor.
- While a value is dragged (for example in the color picker) the LVGL preview redraws at most every 40 ms, so the
  editor stays smooth; the final state is drawn right after.

## Changed

- **Preferences**: a wider window with the categories as cards in two columns.
- **Timeline**: compact steps without the age; the mouse wheel scrolls them sideways. Panels can be made much smaller.
- **Assets** (formerly Images): images as tiles, three per row; fonts as cards, two per row. In the default layout
  Timeline, Fonts and Assets share the area below the canvas (*Preferences → Reset layout*).
